title: Day 49 · Week 7, Day 0 — Body: the week the body gets its edges — fingers from a paddle, a lip from three pieces, a wall down the heart, the calendar a drug disaster wrote, and the first movement nobody feels
summary: Week 7 opens with the fourth Body episode. Your baby is 8–10 mm (the NHS's grape) at the end of Carnegie stage 15: the arm bud split into hand plate and arm, the hand plate about to divide into wrist and digital plate, digital rays by ~Day 55 and free fingers by ~Day 63; a lip assembling from three pieces (CDC: weeks 4–7) and a palate behind it (weeks 6–9); nasal pits turning forward, dark eyes, auricular hillocks; a foramen secundum opening in the upper heart by design while the lower wall grows and the outflow divides, walled off by ~Day 63 and finished by ~Day 70. Why we know the schedule to the day: thalidomide, sold from 1957 for sedation and morning sickness, damaged more than 10,000 children, and Lenz's reconstruction from prescription dates gave a calendar in LMP days — no defects before Day 34 or after Day 50; absent ears Days 35–37, absent arms 39–41, phocomelia with three fingers 43–44, three-jointed thumbs 46–48 — so the limb window closes tomorrow. The three edges with their numbers: the lip (1 in 1,031 cleft lip ± palate; folic acid ≥400 µg aOR 0.61 in 377 Norwegian cases, Wilcox 2007; smoking RR 1.34 across 24 studies, Little 2004; first-trimester fever 1.5–3×, Dreier 2014); the heart (9.1 per 1,000 worldwide across 24 million births, van der Linde 2011; ~40,000 US babies a year, 1 in 4 critical, CDC; pregestational diabetes RR 4.0 — 318 vs 80 per 10,000 — in 2 million Danes, Øyen 2016; NBDPS aOR 3.17 isolated and 8.62 multiple defects, Correa 2008; severe CHD falling 6% a year after flour fortification in 1.3 million Quebec births, Ionescu-Ittu 2009); and the limbs, which after thalidomide are about drugs that cross, handled by the Day 54 audit. The first movement: a one-second sideways bend of head or rump at 7 weeks in 18 IVF embryos (Lüchinger 2008), limbs joining by 8.5 weeks, whole-body general movements at 9–10 weeks, never still more than 13 minutes between 8 and 19 weeks (de Vries 1982, 1985), felt by the mother only at ~16–22 weeks. Scan numbers if it is this week: mean heart rate 125 at Days 46–49 and 145 at 50–52 (Stefos 1998); miscarriage 4.2% after a heartbeat at 7 completed weeks (Tong 2008). The point: the schedule is daily, the list of what can reach it is the same list since Day 29, and the father's job is maintenance, not vigilance.
action: Tonight, ten minutes, in the pregnancy file. Write three dates and what closes on each: Day 56, the lip is fused and the finger rays are drawn; Day 63, the fingers are free and the lower heart is walled off; Day 70, the palate, and the end of organ-building. Under them, four lines already running: folic acid 400 µg every morning; no smoke in the house, hers or yours; over 38 °C (100.4 °F) is acetaminophen and a call; nothing new from a pharmacy, health-food shop or friend's cabinet without the call, and nothing she already takes stopped without it. Then photograph every packet, bottle and tube in the bathroom cabinet, hers and yours, so the Day 54 medication audit starts from a picture. If your partner has diabetes, add one line: her last A1c and when the next one is.
